title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-21
lineage: MR > C > D > CDR > EAC (secure) > CE2K (minor cleanup) > CD Wave > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Dec 21 1969 Fillmore set with a smoking Not Fade Away and strong Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is a stereo soundboard mix that sounds clear and well balanced for its era, though it omits the first six songs of the concert. Musically the show shines on a monster Not Fade Away, a powerful Black Peter and an inspired The Other One, while later tracks like Cumberland Blues feel a bit tired. Overall the performance is lively enough to merit repeated listening despite the incomplete set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical highlights (Not Fade Away, Black Peter) and rate the soundboard mix as good, giving a solid show rating; missing songs and occasional fatigue lower the score slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo soundboard with a decent 1969 mix; clear overall but incomplete (first six songs missing). No major drop‑outs reported, and reviewers note the sound is nice to excellent for the period.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Missing opening six numbers; the recorded portion jumps from Good Lovin' into The Other One and ends after Cumberland Blues, giving an abrupt but interesting flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo on Not Fade Away is praised for smooth licks and a great tone; he also replies “Thank You!” at the close.
band_member_comments.Phil: Only noted saying “Good Night Folks, Merry Christmas” after Cumberland Blues.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s harmonica on Not Fade Away (and backup vocals) is highlighted as a treasure.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum solo in Good Lovin' receives specific praise; overall drumming noted as solid.
